title: Chapter 1151 - 16: Demon Jade Great Saint (Requesting Subscription)

Chapter 1151 - 16: Demon Jade Great Saint (Requesting Subscription)

Chapter 1151: Chapter 16: Demon Jade Great Saint (Requesting Subscription)

"This Great Saint-level secret treasure..."

Lin Yuan emerged from a planet named Spiritual Treasure Star, examining his harvest.

The Spiritual Treasure Star is the place where secret treasure weapons are nurtured in the Xuanhuang Universe, not just one planet.

Unlike the regular methods of forging secret treasure weapons in the Chaos Void, the way of the Xuanhuang line mainly focuses on nurturing.

First forge a secret treasure weapon embryo, then place it into a designated Spiritual Treasure Star, allowing the secret treasure weapon to naturally form over the long years of nurturing.

This method of forging has two major advantages. First, it’s convenient; once the secret treasure weapon embryo is made, that’s all that’s needed. Second, the power of the resulting secret treasure weapon is often superior to those of the same level.

As for the disadvantages? The lack of human interference means it takes too long.

However, if one can obtain a high-powered secret treasure weapon, spending more time is quite normal.

"A Great Saint-level soul and mind defense secret treasure?"

Lin Yuan looked at the yellow ’droplet’ the size of a thumb in front of him, as if watching a vast universe.

Whether it’s Great Saint-level secret treasure weapons or other levels, defensive-type ones are generally valued higher than offensive ones.

After all, compared to kill methods, preserving life is undoubtedly more important.

Among defensive Great Saint secret treasures, soul and mind defense treasures are the most precious.

"Not bad, not bad."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. This defensive Great Saint-level secret treasure, although incomparable to the Life Divine Stone he obtained first, is still highly valuable, unattainable by many Chaos Great Saints even after exhausting one Cosmic Era.

"It’s just... getting closer to the inner region of the Xuanhuang Universe now..."

Lin Yuan glanced around. Every life entering the Xuanhuang Universe randomly appears in the outermost edge region.

And as Lin Yuan continues to explore deeper, he gradually approaches the inner region of the Xuanhuang Universe.

The most apparent sign is Lin Yuan faintly sensing the slight aura of other Chaos Great Saints.

The aura of Chaos Great Saints, when fully unleashed, can be felt even when separated by Void Domain after Void Domain, just that the Xuanhuang Universe’s oppressive rules made Lin Yuan only aware when nearing the inner region.

"No Great Saints share my path."

Lin Yuan carefully senses for a while, concluding.

Other Great Saints do not possess a beast map, are not intimately familiar with the myriad regions within the universe. Given the vastness of the Xuanhuang Universe, the probability that those Great Saints share the same path as Lin Yuan is strikingly low.

"From the inner region onwards, danger will begin to appear."

Lin Yuan’s expression subtly serious. Treasures and wonders from the outer region can generally be taken without significant difficulty.

Because their value is not high.

As for the three-meter large Life Divine Stone? Totally an exception.

Normally, the Life Origin Star’s nurturing of Life Divine Stone has very low efficiency; even spending one Cosmic Era, the final nurtured stone is thumb-sized.

A palm-sized Life Divine Stone can save a heavily injured, dying Chaos Great Saint.

A thumb-sized Life Divine Stone probably can only save a Chaos Realm Venerable.

Therefore, that Life Origin Star merely breeds rare treasures at the normal Chaos Realm level.

However.

A thumb-sized Life Divine Stone nurtured over one Cosmic Era.

Then what about ten Cosmic Eras? A hundred Cosmic Eras? A thousand, ten thousand Cosmic Eras?

Quantity leads to quality change; the Xuanhuang Universe sealed for eons allowed Lin Yuan to harvest such a large piece of Life Divine Stone.

It’s entirely a coincidence plus luck.

"Even if there’s danger, I possess more advantages than those Great Saints."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the beast map has provided immense help.

...

Star Tear ’Fragment World’.

Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit sat cross-legged.

Within the Xuanhuang Universe, his true self is currently proceeding smoothly, only occasionally blocked by Xuanhuang Beasts. As for other Chaos Realms?

The Xuanhuang Universe is vast; over a hundred Venerables and ten Great Saints falling into such a vast universe are akin to a drop of water entering the ocean.

"It’s still the exploration phase now; no conflicts will arise for the time being."

Lin Yuan mused, the so-called conflicts mainly refer to those between Great Saints. Not having reached the inner region, naturally, the Great Saints won’t confront each other, making conflict impossible.

Lin Yuan speculated, conflicts between Great Saints would only arise after penetrating deeper into the inner region.

"With my current strength, I can attempt the Black Tower’s ninth floor."

Lin Yuan suddenly contemplated.

The nine floors of the Demon Jade Black Tower have spanned Lin Yuan’s journey from weak to strong.

He traversed the eighth floor before advancing to the Twelfth Layer. As for the ninth floor?

The ninth floor of the Black Tower is completely different from the previous eight floors; what it requires facing is a mark left by the Moyu Tower Master.

Even though this mark lacks any intellect, existing solely as a fixed ’program’, yet it originates from the Moyu Tower Master, an unparalleled Great Saint.

In Lin Yuan’s eyes, the Moyu Tower Master isn’t much weaker than the Xuanhuang, and according to the Eye of Myriad Laws, the Xuanhuang approaches the status of Invincible Great Saint.

Thus implying, the Moyu Tower Master is of approximately the same level of strength, and his left mark requires at least Chaos Realm peak or even Chaos Great Saint to confidently defeat it.

After entering the Twelfth Layer, Lin Yuan, only at the Path Splitting Realm, even if grown to its pinnacle, could merely match ordinary Chaos Realm Venerables, naturally losing hope of passing the Black Tower’s ninth floor.

Hum.

Lin Yuan separated a sliver of mental will, descending into the Demon Jade Space.

In front of the towering nine-floor Black Tower.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

The six-armed figure Shen Ji emerged, gazing at Lin Yuan with a slightly complex expression.

Lin Yuan hasn’t descended here for a long time. Coming now suggests a likely intention to challenge the ninth floor of the Black Tower.

And with the six-armed figure Shen Ji’s understanding of Lin Yuan, if without certain assurance, Lin Yuan wouldn’t intentionally come.

Especially with Lin Yuan aware the ninth floor of the Black Tower demands facing a mark by the Moyu Tower Master, unless reaching Chaos Realm peak, he wouldn’t even entertain the thought of a venture.

"Chaos Realm peak?"

"That little one from back then, has already grown to this extent?"

The six-armed figure Shen Ji’s thoughts wandered; he watched Lin Yuan grow up to now, and remembers when he saw this little one for the first time, he was merely at the Sixth or Seventh Layer.

In the blink of an eye, he already possesses the power of the peak Chaos Realm?

"I want to attempt the ninth level of the Black Tower," Lin Yuan said.

"Go ahead." The six-armed figure Shen Ji nodded, showing no surprise.

Rumble.

The gate of the ninth level of the Black Tower opened.

Lin Yuan stepped in and appeared on the ninth floor.

Compared to the omnipresent pressure of the previous eight levels, the ninth level was empty, seemingly devoid of anything.

But Lin Yuan remained on high alert.

Soon.

The world turned dark.

A towering figure materialized.

He wore a black robe, his gaze indifferent, seemingly containing the rules of the Great Dao.

This was the imprint left by the Moyu Tower Master manifesting.

When Lin Yuan first faced the Moyu Tower Master’s imprint, he couldn’t withstand even a single glance and his mind completely fell, not even knowing how he was defeated.

But this time, Lin Yuan’s strength had increased manifold, and the Moyu Tower Master’s gaze, though invisibly tugging at his mind, couldn’t shake Lin Yuan’s mental will.

Whoosh!

The Moyu Tower Master quietly watched Lin Yuan, his gaze devoid of emotion, then directly raised his hand and pressed down.

In an instant, the entire heaven and earth fell into darkness; this darkness was exceedingly pure, completely distinct from the Black Light Domain of the Black Light Great Saint.

"Divine Ability ’World’."

Lin Yuan directly transformed into the Fierce Sun, the universe outside his body spreading wildly in all directions, vaguely contending with the Moyu Tower Master’s dark power.

"Too strong."

"Without being a Chaos Great Saint, there’s simply no match."

At this moment, Lin Yuan was utterly certain that a Chaos Realm peak Venerable could not possibly pass the ninth level.

"Time?"

Lin Yuan vaguely sensed a change in the time around him; it wasn’t merely a matter of accelerating or decelerating time, but something deeper.

"The Moyu Tower Master’s strength greatly improved after killing that wondrous life with rich time bloodline, he must have gained a lot from it."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Upon passing the eighth level, he acquired a drop of ’Time Blood’ left by the Moyu Tower Master, originating from that wondrous life with a rich time bloodline.

The Moyu Tower Master did not keep this drop of Time Blood for himself to comprehend, but rather left it in the ninth level of the Black Tower, indicating it was no longer significant for his own understanding.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The glimmer of the Fierce Sun spread, the power of the universe outside suppressing, opposing the dark power gathered by the Moyu Tower Master as he raised his hand; Lin Yuan felt exceedingly uncomfortable.

This discomfort was not due to being helpless against the Moyu Tower Master; in terms of aura intensity, the Moyu Tower Master currently revealed was not as strong as the Dual Origin Great Saint or the Black Light Great Saint.

Yet the pressure this result exerted on Lin Yuan far exceeded that of the previous two Great Saints.

"Heaven Tear."

Lin Yuan grasped with his right hand, and five terrifying marks flashed and vanished, tearing five cracks in the endless dark power around the Moyu Tower Master.

However, shortly after these five cracks appeared, they quickly healed, re-cloaked by the endless dark power.

"There’s no other way."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; the Divine Skill ’Heaven Tear’ was definitely among the top five of his current killing techniques.

Even this divine skill couldn’t defeat the Moyu Tower Master, leaving Lin Yuan with no choice but to use his final move.

"Universe, explode!"

Lin Yuan’s mind moved slightly, and the universe surrounding him suddenly began to collapse.

Since his internal universe fused and devoured the source of the Fierce Sun, detonating his external universe had surpassed the Divine Skill Heaven Tear in might.

After all, this was not just a single divine skill, but a whole new technique formed by the combination of the Thirteenth Layer’s talent, Fierce Sun Open Sky.

Rumble.

The universe outside collapsed, and the Fierce Sun also began to annihilate, the resulting terrifying power tearing every inch of the ninth level of the Black Tower.

Rustle.

The endless dark power raised by the Moyu Tower Master also swiftly disintegrated, until even the imprint left by the Moyu Tower Master rapidly dissolved.

Rumble.

After a long time.

Lin Yuan walked out from the depths of time and space, his aura weakened.

"Is it over?"

Lin Yuan looked around, no longer feeling a trace of the Moyu Tower Master’s aura, and breathed a sigh of relief.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted, looking in a particular direction.

He saw wisp after wisp of dark power converging, once again forming the figure of the Moyu Tower Master.

However, compared to the initial figure’s indifference and ruthlessness,

this time the formed Moyu Tower Master figure had obvious differences; the gaze cast upon Lin Yuan showed an expression of surprise, as if it had ’come to life.’

.....
